native.method: Fixture-start native integration. Current-engine-derived Wishing Woods save seeded only into an isolated QA profile, followed by actual Alt+F4/reopen. Actual Play/Continue, keyboard Right, Left, on-screen pad Right; 96→97→98→99 steps. Actual Sound/Regular→Zippy change, normal Alt+F4/reopen, Play/Continue and final normal close. Passive observer bound to exact executable/PID/start/profile/CDP ancestry. No Human save or physical-touch test.
observations: Three jumps each commit one action and return to settled state; two follower DOM roots return.
All raw active-run, durable-progress and presentation-preference strings match exactly after reopen, including changed Zippy pace.

Two early root native captures showed number/boots before Ame/weapon painted; third actual mid-jump capture showed complete actor. Inherited async image remount/capture timing remains a visual follow-up, not claimed fixed or continuously visible.
rejectedAttempts: Initial fixture-seed guard used path instead of PowerShell Path and failed before mutation; corrected setup recorded separately.
Initial ad-hoc preference check addressed parsedStorage wrapper instead of its value; exact raw equality passed and corrected value.pace assertion passes here.
limitations: Follower DOM presence does not establish every painted frame or visible separation when followers overlap Ame.
Passive observer changes overhead; not native frame-time, acoustic, physical-iPad/touch, continuous sprite visibility, clean-machine or signing acceptance.
